_comment: Atmosphere & recovery chunk 2, §6.2 (decided): the campfire's heal. Uncapped (maxTargets 0) — a campfire heals EVERY wounded aligned entity in range (players + summons/companions), no lowest-health pick. Heals in combat: yes (v1) — attrition rides the chunk-1 regen gate. Cadence sized so zero-to-full ≈ 15–20 s (GDD §3 rhythm): 6 HP per 30-tick (~1 s) tick on a 100-HP pool ≈ 17 s. No resource cost — pricing is a player build lever, and a mob is not a costPayer at all, so it could not pay one. Triage item 13: heals healFractionOfMax (percent of each TARGET's max HP) instead of a flat amount, so higher-level pools restore at the same rate; 0.12 [PLACEHOLDER], the % value itself is C8's regen/downtime settlement. Chunk 3 adds the big light_aura (rendering-only, streams as light_radius) — the first unequal-radii skill: heal stays r1.5 via the per-effect range check, light never touches sensor/aura_radius. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
